## Raw(object?) {#TinyComponents_RenderableText_Raw_System_Object_}

Creates an new instance of [RenderableText](https://docs.sisk-framework.org/api/TinyComponents.RenderableText.md) with the provided raw, unencoded text.

```csharp
public static RenderableText Raw(object? contents)
```

### Parameters

`contents` [object](https://learn.microsoft.com/dotnet/api/system.object)?

The object which will be converted to text.

### Returns

[RenderableText](https://docs.sisk-framework.org/api/TinyComponents.RenderableText.md)

An [RenderableText](https://docs.sisk-framework.org/api/TinyComponents.RenderableText.md) with the content value.
